headline: Vote on continued need for South Lawrence Branch property, and review of library director's evaluation and contract.
summary: Items include the library's semi-annual report for City Council, a draft policy compilation, and changes to the meeting room policy. Trustees will also discuss new subcommittees, bylaw revisions, and a proposed subcommittee description.
